# Standard Names & Abbreviations

| Usage | Standard Form |
| --- | --- |
| Brand name | Kuailu Technology |
| Brand mark | KUAILUTECH |
| AI CRM product | Kuailu AI CRM |
| International legal entity | Kuailu Technology (HK) Limited |
| Mainland China legal entity | Shenzhen Kuailu Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳快鹭科技有限公司) |

Do not introduce unapproved abbreviations, translated legal names or product aliases.
